description:
The pinnacle of racing technology. The all-new Panigale V4 R represents the pinnacle of Ducati racing technology, applied to a model approved for road use, built with exclusive technical solutions derived from victories in MotoGP and WorldSBK.

Join Nicolò Bulega and Alessandro Valia as they dive into its power, handling and racing soul.

See more at https: https://ducat.it/PanigaleV4R

Racing is just the beginning
